scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [12.3846924626345, -5.46304863912067] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted.
The bounded request used a 0.02-degree box around the exact point and returned zero features; no citywide count or municipal-boundary query was performed.
The WFS advertised extent ending at longitude -6.053873462910213 is a service coverage limit, not proof that Koutiala lacks cadastral records elsewhere.
